title_candidates: GPT-Live makes ChatGPT Voice feel less turn-based
summary: OpenAI started rolling out GPT-Live in ChatGPT Voice, with full-duplex conversation, better listening, visual answers, and different access by plan.

primary_source.title: Introducing GPT-Live
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI introduced GPT-Live as a new generation of voice models for ChatGPT Voice.
GPT-Live is built for full-duplex interaction, so it can listen and speak at the same time instead of waiting for rigid turns.
The model can delegate harder questions to a frontier model in the background while keeping the conversation moving.
GPT-Live is rolling out globally across ChatGPT on iOS, Android, and the web, with GPT-Live-1 for paid consumer plans and GPT-Live-1 mini for Free users.
The help page says Live does not initially support video, screen sharing, connected apps, or plugins, and Business, Enterprise, and Edu workspaces do not get Live at launch.

steps.instruction: Open ChatGPT on mobile or web and tap the Voice button in a normal chat.
If your account shows voice choices, open Settings, then Voice, and pick Live.
Ask one simple planning question, pause mid-sentence, then continue to see whether it waits instead of interrupting.
Ask one date-sensitive question and verify the answer with the exact date and your time zone.
If Live is not available, check whether you are in a Business, Enterprise, or Edu workspace, or wait for the rollout to reach your account.

risk_flags: Rollout availability varies by plan, region, app version, and workspace type.
